item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera heats some sugar in a dry test tube in her school laboratory. She observes that a black solid is left behind and droplets of water collect on the cooler parts of the tube.

What does this experiment show about sugar?

options.A: Sugar is an element because it leaves behind only one black solid.
options.B: Sugar is a compound because it breaks down on heating to give carbon and water, showing it contains more than one element.
options.C: Sugar is a mixture because it gives two different products on heating.
options.D: Sugar is an element because the water droplets come from the sugar, not from the air.
